task: Design a 4-question behavioral interview loop for a 'Senior Product Manager' role to specifically probe for: (1) ability to say no to a stakeholder, (2) evidence-based prioritization, (3) cross-functional conflict resolution. Give each question plus one follow-up probe, and one red-flag answer pattern to watch for per question.
rubric: Score 0-1 on: (a) each of the 3 target competencies is actually covered by at least one question (not all 4 questions vaguely testing the same thing); (b) each question is behavioral (asks for a real past example), not hypothetical ('what would you do if...'); (c) the follow-up probes are genuinely designed to catch a rehearsed or vague answer, not generic ('tell me more'); (d) the red-flag pattern per question is specific and diagnostic (e.g. 'answer has no measurable outcome' or 'candidate blames the stakeholder entirely'), not generic ('bad communication').
